meta_description: A summarized list of necessary and specific agendas for the non-binary community, from ABRANB consultations and debates.
topics: Access to architecture and the city
Access to health and the "gender-affirming" process
Access to education free of binarism and transphobia
Access to data, information, and media
Access to land and permanence on the land
Access to budget for non-binary and trans community projects in general
Access to protection and dignity regarding the prison system
Access to personal and collective recognition in language
